# ZusammenLeben

> Free volunteer support for Ukrainian families in Northern Bavaria: housing, Jobcenter, Anmeldung, school places and translation in Hof, Selb, Helmbrechts.

ZusammenLeben is a volunteer initiative based in Konradsreuth (Alte Hofer Str. 1, 95176 Konradsreuth, Bavaria, Germany). Founded in 2022 by Ben Shamir; daily operations are managed by Anna Cheishvili.
It supports Ukrainian families in Upper Franconia (Oberfranken), Northern Bavaria: Hof, Helmbrechts, Münchberg, Selb, Wunsiedel, Arzberg, Marktredwitz, Naila, Kulmbach and Bad Steben.
Help is free of charge and given in Ukrainian, Russian, German and English: housing, Jobcenter procedures, address registration (Anmeldung), school and kindergarten places, furniture and translation.
Contact: WhatsApp +380 63 700 4615, email zusammenleben.de@gmail.com. The site is available in English (/), German (/de/) and Ukrainian (/ua/).

## Main pages
- [Help for Ukrainian Families in Upper Franconia](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/): Free volunteer support for Ukrainian families in Northern Bavaria: housing, Jobcenter, Anmeldung, school places and translation in Hof, Selb, Helmbrechts.
- [Our Story: How ZusammenLeben Began](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/social-activity.html): How a real estate entrepreneur in Northern Bavaria turned company apartments into homes for Ukrainian families, and how the support network grew.
- [Anna Cheishvili, Operations Manager](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/anna-shishoili.html): Meet Anna Cheishvili, the volunteer operations manager of ZusammenLeben and the first contact for Ukrainian families in Upper Franconia.
- [Our Services: Housing, Jobcenter & School Help](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/services.html): What we actually do for Ukrainian families in Northern Bavaria: housing, Jobcenter support, Anmeldung, schools, furniture and translation, free of charge.
- [Request Assistance: How to Reach Us](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/request-assistance.html): Ask ZusammenLeben for help by WhatsApp, email or form in Ukrainian, Russian, German or English. What to include so we can answer quickly.
- [German Glossary for Newcomers from Ukraine](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/glossary.html): The German words you meet at the Jobcenter, town hall and school, explained simply: Anmeldung, Bescheid, Kaution, Widerspruch and many more.
- [Learning German in Upper Franconia](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/learning-german.html): Ways to learn German for Ukrainian families in Northern Bavaria: integration courses, language cafés, online tools and practice in daily life.
- [Rights of Ukrainian Refugees in Germany](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/refugee-rights.html): Your rights with temporary protection in Germany: residence, work, benefits, health care, school and where to get independent advice.
- [Areas We Serve: Hof, Selb, Helmbrechts & More](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/areasweserve.html): We focus on Upper Franconia in Northern Bavaria: Hof, Helmbrechts, Münchberg, Selb, Wunsiedel, Marktredwitz, Naila, Kulmbach and nearby towns.
- [Our Community in Upper Franconia](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/community.html): Families, volunteers and local partners who make a new start possible for Ukrainians in Northern Bavaria. How to take part and stay connected.
- [Family Stories: Letters of Gratitude](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/family-stories.html): Letters and stories from Ukrainian families who found a home and a new start in Upper Franconia with the help of ZusammenLeben.
- [FAQ for Ukrainian Newcomers in Bavaria](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/faq.html): Answers to the most common questions of Ukrainian families in Northern Bavaria: housing, Jobcenter, registration, school, health and our support.
- [How You Can Help Ukrainian Families](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/how-to-help.html): Support Ukrainian families in Upper Franconia: offer an apartment, donate furniture, translate, drive to appointments or volunteer your time.
- [Emergency Numbers and Help in Germany](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/emergency.html): Emergency numbers, on-call doctors, crisis lines and local contacts for Ukrainian families in Upper Franconia. What to do in an urgent situation.
- [Contact ZusammenLeben](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/Contact.html): Contact ZusammenLeben in Konradsreuth, Upper Franconia, by WhatsApp, phone, email or contact form. We reply in Ukrainian, Russian, German and English.
- [Living in Germany: Orientation Guide](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/living-in-germany.html): An orientation guide for families from Ukraine: German terms, procedures and official requirements you meet during your first year in Germany.

## Guides
- [Guides for Ukrainian Families in Germany](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guides.html)
- [Finding an Apartment in Upper Franconia with Jobcenter Support](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-finding-apartment.html): Step by step: how Ukrainian families find a flat in Upper Franconia, get Jobcenter approval for the rent and avoid the most common mistakes.
- [How to Read and Answer Jobcenter Letters](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-jobcenter-letters.html): Bescheid, Einladung, Mitwirkung: what the most common Jobcenter letters mean, which deadlines matter and how to reply on time without losing benefits.
- [Registering Your Child for School or Kita in Bavaria](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-school-kita-bavaria.html): How to register a child from Ukraine for school or kindergarten in Bavaria: compulsory schooling, German classes, documents and realistic waiting times.
- [Health Insurance and Seeing a Doctor in Germany](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-health-insurance-doctor.html): How health insurance works for people from Ukraine in Germany, how to choose a family doctor, and which numbers to call at night and in emergencies.
- [Getting Your Ukrainian Qualifications Recognised in Germany](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-recognition-qualifications.html): Which professions need official recognition in Germany, where to apply, which documents you need and who can pay the costs for Ukrainian diplomas.
- [The Integration Course: Your Fastest Route to German](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-integration-course.html): What the German integration course includes, how people from Ukraine get a place, what it costs and how the final B1 exam works. A practical guide.
- [Your §24 Residence Permit: What You Need to Know](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-residence-permit-24.html): Temporary protection under §24 explained: validity, extensions, what to do before your card expires and when to contact the immigration office.
- [Finding Your First Job in Germany](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-first-job.html): Where Ukrainians find work in Upper Franconia, how Minijobs and contracts work, what to report to the Jobcenter and how to write a German CV.
- [Bank Account, Phone Contract and Broadcasting Fee](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-bank-account-phone.html): How people from Ukraine open a German bank account, choose a phone contract safely, and deal with the broadcasting fee letter. Practical tips and rights.
- [Driving in Germany with a Ukrainian Licence](https://zusammenleben-ukraine.de/guide-driving-licence.html): Can you drive in Germany with a Ukrainian licence? Validity under temporary protection, when to exchange it, insurance and car registration explained.
